_readme: Facts transcribed from the dashboard mockup's research packet, plus the everyday questions a toastie shop gets on the phone (plan 0012). OWNER-UNVERIFIED: every value is a plausible default for Tony to correct.

hours.value: 7:30am to 2:30pm Monday to Friday, and 8am to 3pm on Saturday. Closed Sunday.

parking.value: Eaton Mall is pedestrian-only. There's two-hour street parking on Atherton Road and Portman Street, and the Oakleigh Central car park is a two-minute walk.

bookings_policy.value: Walk-ins are always welcome. We recommend booking for groups of four or more, and we hold a booked table for ten minutes.

delivery.value: We don't deliver at the moment, it's takeaway only. Phone ahead and your order is ready in about ten minutes.

takeaway.value: Everything on the menu is available takeaway. Phone orders are ready in about ten minutes.

catering.value: We do platters for ten to forty people with two days' notice. Tony confirms the menu and price with you by phone.

dietary.value: The Wise Guy and The Frank Fungini are vegetarian. We don't have vegan or halal-certified options at the moment.

kids.value: Kids are welcome. We have two high chairs and can do a half toastie for little ones.

dogs.value: Dogs are welcome at the outdoor tables, and there's a water bowl by the door.

coffee.value: Yes, we do espresso coffee from a local Oakleigh roaster, plus cold drinks.

accessibility.value: Step-free entry from the mall and an accessible table inside. The nearest accessible toilet is in Oakleigh Central.

payment.value: We take card and cash, including contactless and Apple Pay, with no minimum spend.

public_holidays.value: We're closed on public holidays. Check our Instagram for the Christmas and Easter hours.

wifi.value: Free wifi for customers, just ask at the counter for the password.

gift_vouchers.value: Gift cards start at twenty dollars and are sold at the counter.

alcohol.value: We're not licensed and not BYO, we're a daytime cafe.

wait_time.value: The lunch rush is twelve to one thirty, when a table can be a ten to fifteen minute wait. Before noon you'll walk straight in.

jobs.value: We're not hiring right now. Email a CV to tony@uncletony.com.au and Tony keeps them on file.

loyalty.value: No loyalty card yet. Follow @uncletony.au on Instagram for the weekly specials.
